title: Hoardwing's Borrowed Shine
story: Hoardwing the Magpie Wraith has spent a hundred years snatching coins from the fishing village and stuffing them into her cliffside nest. She isn't wicked, just terribly fond of shiny things, and when Mr 6 offers her a mirror-bright shield polish she gladly gives everything back. Now the coins must be shared out fairly.
question: The recovered nest holds 3 chests of 148 coins each, to be shared equally among the 12 fishing families. How many coins does each family get?
hint: Find the total number of coins in all three chests before you split anything twelve ways.
victory: Every family got exactly 37 coins with none left over, and Hoardwing perched on Mr 6's helmet admiring her reflection. 'Sharing,' she croaked, 'is shinier than I expected.'
imagePrompt: A glossy black magpie wraith on a windy cliffside nest of spilled gold coins, with a numeral-six knight stacking equal little coin piles as fishing villagers climb up in dawn light.
